'''Maccus''' is a male NPC located in [[Capitoline Hill City]] down in the arena hallway. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Maccus:''' Welcome to Colosseum Olymdos. Is there anything you'd wish to learn about this place?
:{{DIcon}} About the Colosseum...
::'''Maccus:''' Colosseum Olymdos is the most renowned arena in the city, and the hosting ground of the largest Echo tournament ever to exist—the Great Agon.
::'''Maccus:''' Though the oval-shaped arena was built six hundred years ago, we apply the most advanced and modern technologies within every match.
::'''Maccus:''' One can even say that the Colosseum is a microcosm of the city of Septimont.
:{{DIcon}} About the Great Agon...
::'''Maccus:''' The Great Agon, held every four years, is the grandest event there is in Septimont!
::'''Maccus:''' Gladiators gear up for battle, with their dreams and passion at their shoulders as they march into the arena!
::'''Maccus:''' You can feel everyone's anticipation brewing as we wait for the reveal of this year's champion!
:{{DIcon}} About the teams...
::'''Maccus:''' We've got quite a big competition this year... The most popular ones so far are Beasts Beneath, Vulcan Mining, Blue Furies...
::'''Maccus:''' And of course, the team led by {{Rover}} and [[Lupa]]!
::'''Maccus:''' Which teams will contend for the championship? Let's find out!
{{Dialogue End}}
